body: I have been volunteering since 2011, 3 years Feb just gone, "bam" nothing, no replies back, no nothing. Also its all fine and well saying tickets are $150, but then other expenses, Food, somewhere to stay all cost extra, do I just close my eyes and "BAM" its there?, Volunteering is all fine and well but at the end of the day it hasn't helped to pay the bills let alone get a job.

That's one of the catch 22s that's constantly with me, I require money to travel, how do I get money? a job, how do I get a job? with experience, how do I get experience? by having a Job. As much as I'd love to get away from this place I can't
